findings.title: Stale setting_id persists for Git datasource
findings.problem: Git was removed from the single-option auto-select list, and nothing clears setting_id for Git. If the form switches from an auto-selected type (e.g. Jira) to Git with exactly one Git option, the old setting_id stays. The else-branch compares projectName with getValues('projectName'), which is normally equal, so it does not clear it either. No other code in the datasource form resets setting_id on type change.
findings.impact: Git creation may not start empty (the acceptance criterion) and may submit an integration id from another type. Before this change the Git auto-select overwrote it. Reachability was not fully confirmed: it depends on the type-switch flow.
findings.recommendation: For Git, explicitly clear setting_id in this effect when it is not a valid Git option, e.g. if (indexType === INDEX_TYPES.GIT && !newSettingOptions.some(o => o.id === getValues('setting_id'))) setValue('setting_id', undefined).
